task.title: Root package discovery fix from changesets/bot appears to be missing
task.body:
The root-package discovery issue fixed in https://github.com/changesets/bot/pull/94 appears to still exist in `changesets-gitlab`.

Package discovery checks `item.endsWith('/package.json')`, which does not match the root-level `package.json`. In a pnpm workspace containing both the root package and child packages—even with `.` explicitly included—the comment command fails with:

> Found changeset … for package … which is not in the workspace

The Changesets CLI recognizes the root package correctly.

#257 addressed the case where `pnpm-workspace.yaml` has no `packages` field, but not this multi-package workspace case.

Encountered on 0.15.1; the same discovery condition is still present in the published 0.17.0 source.

Could the upstream fix be brought over?
